integrity: The infinite distance formula is proved from the published bipermutation adjacency rule by a copy-inversion lower bound and an explicit path; breadth-first search is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the distance for one canonical reversal pair, not the full graph diameter or all-pairs metric.
The special case \(n=2\) has distance 2 rather than \(n^2-1\).
Targeted literature searches cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent statement under different terminology.
title: Quadratic reversal distance in the bipermutahedron
